name: x-now
description: X-Now — a native desktop shell for x.com built with Tauri v2 (Rust). There is no JS build step: frontend/x-tools.js is embedded into the binary via include_str!. This manifest exists to pin the dev/test tooling used by scripts/verify-xnow-helpers.js and scripts/xnow-flash-smoke-test.js.

scripts.build: cd src-tauri && cargo build --release && npx --yes @tauri-apps/cli@2 build --bundles nsis,msi
